races.verdict: KINDACAN disappointed when down the field at Dundalk 4 weeks ago, yet her debut third over C&D was a promising effort and she's afforded another chance back on turf. races.display_title: DNG Nationwide Handicap
races.verdict: Successful at Navan on his penultimate start, MOLTOPHINO subsequently shaped very well when third over 5f here 3 weeks ago. The return to this trip will hold no fears and he could well be ready to strike again. Keke , last year's winner Unique Journey and Amiata head up the dangers, with Dark Ace another to consider in a highly-competitive handicap. MOLTOPHINO (IRE) KEKE UNIQUE JOURNEY (IRE)

races.verdict: BIRKETT BANK gave the odds-on favourite most to do on debut at Wolverhampton last month and is excused her next outing so could be worth chancing for her in-form yard. Lovely Dark Angel ran below the form of her qualifying runs in nursery company at Leicester last time but could bounce back returned to all-weather, while Leucothea has bags of experience and bounced back to form with cheekpieces fitted at Epsom last time. BIRKETT BANK LOVELY DARK ANGEL (IRE) LEUCOTHEA (IRE)
